manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to pay for commnader tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control can tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Zacama enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control can tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
